fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that goods worth about Rs. 40,000 (grocery stock) were found missing from Green Leaf Stores, a shop near Senthil Garden Main Street in Salem. The matter was brought to Salem West PS on 2025-04-13, while the incident was placed on 2025-04-11 at roughly 09:45. The complainant is associated with the business Green Leaf Stores. The complainant alleged that Tamilarasan Muthu may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000260. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as a customer and took items while staff were attending to others.
fields.Keywords: shop theft, stock, mobile number, main street, documents, suspect, morning
